verdict.rationale: Gunderson's Employment & Labor practice page says clients can self-serve employment offer letters, proprietary information agreements, and invention assignment agreements at no cost. Its About page backs this with a self-service Contract Generator and GDHQ's tailored DIY contract generator, and the practice includes nationally recognized non-compete and trade-secret expertise. missing for 10: explicit mention of full employment agreements (beyond offer letters), detail on attorney-drafted versus template-generated paperwork, independent or hands-on corroboration.
